Class CLIView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.CLIView
All Implemented Interfaces:
View
public class CLIView extends Object implements View
Command Line Interface (CLI) implementation of the game view.

This class handles all user interactions through the console, following the MVC pattern. It displays the game state to the user and forwards user inputs to the server via the NetworkManager. All visuals are constrained to standard ASCII. * @author YourName
